description:
Math on a Sheet of Glass, Extended with User-Made Scripties. A WinUI 3 Calculator for Windows 11!

Lamina ✦ is a WinUI 3 calculator that is not only includes a Regular Calculator but also something called "Scripties". She supports Mensuration, Finance, Currency Conversion, Unit Conversions And More!, making her a Very Extendable Option.
- BRAND NEW SELF-UPDATER! ( WITH CONSENT )
Here's a Preview of the Updater. DO NOTE ITS SLOW AS IT'S RUNNING OFF A LOCAL SERVER FOR TESTING!
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/229aed81-a052-4156-940f-da920fc811c9
- Update Check now Runs on Startup of App!
- SHA-256 Checksum Verification in Updater for Maximum Safety!
- NEW SETTING Check for Updates! YES it disables Update Checks on Startup!
- Use of Icons in Buttons. ( Ahem FOSS-Root-Checker ! )
- Faster update checking from repo-data.json instead of Github Gists.
- Quadratic Equation Solver now supports Imaginary Roots ( Yes 💀 )
- Replaced Heart in Onboarding UI with a FLOWER! ( Because we can 🌸, Also a Heart is Cringe without Context 😭)
- Made the Version Tapping Easter Egg make more Sense! ( HINT : (✿◡‿◡) )
- Cleaner Update Checker Messages!
